Frontend UI tested end-to-end with Playwright: inline image upload, floating toolbar (align left/center/right, sizes 25/50/75/100, preview), blue frame + resize handle drag, size label %, persistence through reload, and client (read-only) view keeps size/alignment without toolbar. integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'Mixed Content: ... http://leadflow-crm-75.preview.emergentagent.com/api/' blocked (requests to GET /api/projects/project-1/tasks/.../images/{id}). Image data-width/data-align attributes still render correctly from the HTML, but blob src cannot load over http. action_items: Investigate Mixed Content http:// vs https:// for client-role axios instance (likely in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js) — only observed on client login (admin was fine). Not caused by this iteration but surfaced during tests.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageTools.applyLayout clears width when data-width is missing — good; but sets marginLeft='auto' only when align is center/right and marginRight='auto' only when align=center. For align='right' marginRight is not reset to 0, which can leave a stale centered margin if a user switches center -> right -> left -> right on the same image across sessions. Minor cosmetic edge case.

ImageTools.startResize uses a dir multiplier `(align==='right' ? -1 : 1) * (align==='center' ? 2 : 1)` which collapses to 2 for 'center' (positive, growing both sides) but to -1 for 'right' (ignores the ×2). The right-aligned image therefore resizes 1× instead of 2× (one-sided), which is what the user wants. OK but worth a code comment.
TaskDescription.serialize always calls tidy() on a clone before PATCH — client cannot inject style/onerror. Good.

backend/rich_text.py allows data-width to be any 10-100 integer but reads value.isdigit() which also matches multi-byte Arabic/Thai digits. Could be tightened to re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', value). Low risk.
ImageTools subscribes to window 'resize' + ResizeObserver but never cleans up before unmount only on dep change; dep list [editor] is stable so fine.

rca of the issue: No bug reported. Boundary tests confirm data-width must be a 10..100 integer (9 and 101 are stripped), '50px' is stripped (non-digit), and uppercase 'LEFT' is stripped (case-sensitive allow-list).
